1	# Implementation Plan: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing
2	
3	**Branch**: `004-stt-ocr-processing` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)
4	
5	**Date**: 2026-10-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
6	
7	**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md`
8	§1 (RF02), §6.2 (`/media/ocr`, `/entries`), §13 (technical constraints), `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md`
9	§2.3/§4, and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on RF01 (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`, already
10	implemented) whose placeholder recognition UX (its own FR-007) this unit replaces for the Áudio and Foto tabs.
11	
12	## Summary
13	
14	RF01 already wired the real pipelines this unit needs — `whisper_ggml` transcription, the `media-ocr` call,
15	and `POST /entries` — but fused each modality's recognition and entry-creation into one atomic, auto-saving
16	step behind a plain spinner (FR-007's deliberate placeholder). This unit splits that single step into two:
17	recognition (transcription/OCR) now runs alone, driving dedicated "Processando"/"Transcrevendo" and
18	"Reconhecendo texto..." states (prototype-extract.md §2.3), and lands on an editable review state
19	("Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") with its own explicit "Salvar" — no entry exists until that tap. A prototype-
20	faithful "Erro" state replaces RF01's own deliberately plain failure band for both modalities (research.md R11
21	is now superseded by this unit, as spec.md's Clarification 1 always intended), adding Foto's extra "Salvar só
22	a foto" exit. `InsertionModalBloc`'s audio/photo handlers, `InsertionModalState`/`InsertionModalEvent`, and the
23	two per-modality save usecases are rewritten; `AudioTranscriptionRepository`, `PhotoRecognitionRepository`, and
24	every other RF01 repository/data source are reused completely unchanged — this unit adds no new network call
25	shape and no backend/contract change (FR-013).
26	
27	## Technical Context
28	
29	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from F000/RF03/RF01.
30	
31	**Primary Dependencies**: No additions. Reuses RF01's full stack as-is — `whisper_ggml` (on-device transcription,
32	Constitution Principle II), `image_picker`, `connectivity_plus` (via `ConnectivityChecker`), `dio` (via
33	`ApiClient`), `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `get_it`, `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `record` is
34	untouched — this unit never changes how audio is captured, only what happens after `stop()` returns a path.
35	
36	**Storage**: No change to RF01's storage shape. `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private) keep
37	their RF01 role (the held file for a retry without re-recording/re-picking) and gain one new responsibility:
38	surviving the newly-split Processando→Transcrito/Reconhecido boundary, not just the old single Saving state.
39	`EntriesRepositoryImpl.cachedEntries` (in-memory, `get_it` `lazySingleton`) is unchanged.
40	
41	**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, unchanged tooling. Coverage via
42	`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter (RNF07), now exercising the two rewritten
43	usecases below instead of `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase`. `whisper_ggml`/`image_picker` still
44	have no platform channel under `flutter_test` — quickstart.md covers manual iOS Simulator verification for the
45	new review/retry/"Salvar só a foto" flows the widget tests can't exercise.
46	
47	**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. No native project file touched (no new permission, no
48	deployment-target change) — this unit is pure Dart/Flutter logic and UI on top of RF01's already-provisioned
49	native capabilities.
50	
51	**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app, same two feature folders RF01 created
52	(`lib/features/capture/`, `lib/features/entries/`) — no new feature folder. No backend/server code, no change
53	to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.
54	
55	**Performance Goals**: RNF01 unchanged — the `media-ocr` call still shows a loading affordance past 300 ms
56	(now the prototype's own spinner-plus-caption, not the generic indicator); the Áudio tab's "Processando" state
57	also appears immediately on stop (on-device transcription itself has no network latency to gate on, but still
58	renders a spinner for the duration of the Whisper inference call, which commonly exceeds 300 ms on-device).
59	Toggling "Salvar" enabled/disabled as the reviewed text's emptiness changes stays a local, <100 ms action
60	(FR-009), identical in spirit to the Texto tab's existing toggle.
61	
62	**Constraints**:
63	- No RF04/RF05/RF06/RF07/RF08/RF09/RF10 behavior, no extension feature — FR-012 (unchanged from RF01).
64	- No backend/contract/config change (FR-013) — the same two functions RF01 already calls
65	  (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) are called with the same request shapes; this unit changes only *when* and
66	  *how many times* they are called relative to recognition, never their payloads.
67	- Audio content never reaches the backend (Constitution Principle II, FR-004) — unchanged; transcription
68	  stays entirely on-device, and the connectivity gate that used to run *before* transcription (RF01
69	  research.md R5) is deliberately removed for audio in this unit (research.md R1 below) since transcription
70	  itself needs no connectivity and spec.md's FR-001 requires it to start unconditionally on stop.
71	- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V) — the two new/rewritten usecases
72	  (`RecognizePhotoUseCase`, `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`) stay in `capture/domain/usecases/` and
73	  `entries/domain/usecases/`-adjacent territory, free of `package:flutter`/`dio`/`image_picker` types, same as
74	  every usecase RF01 already shipped.
75	- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this unit, unlike
76	  RF01, *does* need to render the prototype's actual "Erro" iconography/copy (research.md R2 below) and a
77	  photo thumbnail, so it adds the small number of new tokens research.md R2 justifies.
78	
79	**Scale/Scope**: 0 new feature folders; 1 new domain usecase (`RecognizePhotoUseCase`), 1 usecase
80	consolidation (`SaveAudioEntryUseCase` + `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` → one `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, since both
81	become identical except for the hardcoded `EntrySource` once recognition moves out of them — data-model.md);
82	8 new/renamed `InsertionModalState` subclasses (4 per modality) and 5 new `InsertionModalEvent` subclasses;
83	3 widget files edited (`audio_tab_view.dart`, `foto_tab_view.dart`, `insertion_modal_page.dart`'s tab-mapping
84	switch); 2 new design tokens (`sizePhotoThumbnail`, `sizeStatusIcon`).
85	
86	## Constitution Check
87	
88	*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this section.*
89	
90	| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
91	|---|---|---|
92	| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only. This unit's genuinely silent spots — the exact UI for a *save-call* failure after a successful recognition (the prototype's "Erro" states are reserved for recognition failures, not post-review save failures), the fixed placeholder string for "Salvar só a foto", and whether audio transcription still needs a pre-flight connectivity check — are resolved by reasonable technical judgment in research.md R1/R3/R4, each built directly on spec.md's own already-resolved Clarifications rather than reopening them. |
93	| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | No new package. `whisper_ggml` stays Principle II's fixed, non-negotiable choice; audio still never reaches the backend. |
94	| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | The exact same two functions RF01 already calls (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`), same `ApiClient`/bearer-auth path, same AI-involved steps happening entirely inside the backend. No new function, no contract change. |
95	| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | The prototype's "Erro" states (red warning icon, exact copy, named retry/placeholder actions) are now faithfully rendered — RF01's research.md R11 carve-out is this unit's to close, per spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1. Two new tokens (`sizePhotoThumbnail`, `sizeStatusIcon`, research.md R2) cover the one genuinely new visual element (the photo thumbnail) and the recurring warning icon; everything else (spinner, "Transcrevendo..."/"Reconhecendo texto..." captions, editable field, "Salvar" button, frozen/faded waveform via `Opacity`) reuses RF01's existing token scale and `AudioWaveform` widget unchanged. |
96	| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | No new feature folder. `RecognizePhotoUseCase`/`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` live in `capture/domain/usecases/`, importing only `fpdart`, `core/network/failure.dart`, `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`, and existing domain repository interfaces — no `package:flutter`, no `data/` class. |
97	| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Unchanged call sites, now with the prototype's own loading affordances instead of the generic one past the same 300 ms threshold. |
98	| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF02 | Backend-side, unaffected by this unit. |
99	| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to RF02 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit. |
100	| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | Same `always_use_package_imports`/domain-purity convention RF01 already set up; no new violation surface introduced by splitting the two usecases apart. |
101	| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | `RecognizePhotoUseCase` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` are pure orchestrations of injected interfaces (`PhotoRecognitionRepository`/`ConnectivityChecker`, `CreateEntryUseCase`/`ConnectivityChecker`), as straightforwardly testable against fakes as RF01's originals — see quickstart.md. |
102	| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS | This unit is precisely the one that closes RF01's documented, spec-sanctioned fidelity carve-out (research.md R11 in specs/003) for the Áudio/Foto "Erro" states — see research.md R4 here. |
103	| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, unchanged count | Still 6/15 cumulative from RF01's `entries-create`/`media-ocr` coverage — this unit restructures *where* those three-scenario checks live (now inside `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`/`RecognizePhotoUseCase` rather than the old combined usecases) without adding a new write endpoint. `AudioTranscriptionRepository` still deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`, not the backend taxonomy (RF01 research.md R7, unchanged). |
104	
105	*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*
106	
107	## Project Structure
108	
109	### Documentation (this feature)
110	
111	```text
112	specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/
113	├── plan.md              # This file
114	├── research.md          # Phase 0 output
115	├── data-model.md        # Phase 1 output
116	├── quickstart.md         # Phase 1 output
117	├── contracts/            # Phase 1 output
118	│   ├── insertion-modal-bloc.md
119	│   └── recognition-and-save-usecases.md
120	└── tasks.md              # Phase 2 output (/speckit-tasks — not created here)
121	```
122	
123	### Source Code (repository root)
124	
125	RF01's `lib/features/capture/` and `lib/features/entries/` already exist. This unit edits files inside them
126	and `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`; it creates no new top-level or feature-level directory.
127	
128	```text
129	cerne-ciclo-a/
130	└── lib/
131	    ├── core/
132	    │   └── design_tokens.dart                                 # + sizePhotoThumbnail, sizeStatusIcon (research.md R2)
133	    ├── features/
134	    │   ├── capture/
135	    │   │   ├── domain/
136	    │   │   │   └── usecases/
137	    │   │   │       ├── recognize_photo_usecase.dart             # NEW — connectivity gate + PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()
138	    │   │   │       ├── confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart          # NEW — replaces save_audio_entry_usecase.dart + save_photo_entry_usecase.dart
139	    │   │   │       ├── save_audio_entry_usecase.dart             # DELETED (data-model.md)
140	    │   │   │       └── save_photo_entry_usecase.dart             # DELETED (data-model.md)
141	    │   │   └── presentation/
142	    │   │       ├── bloc/
143	    │   │       │   ├── insertion_modal_event.dart                # + AudioReviewTextChanged, AudioSaveConfirmed, PhotoReviewTextChanged, PhotoSaveConfirmed, PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested
144	    │   │       │   ├── insertion_modal_state.dart                 # + *Processing, *Transcrito/*Reconhecido, *SaveFailure states (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md)
145	    │   │       │   └── insertion_modal_bloc.dart                  # audio/photo handlers rewritten to call recognition and save as two separate steps
146	    │   │       ├── pages/
147	    │   │       │   └── insertion_modal_page.dart                  # _tabOf switch extended for the new state cases
148	    │   │       └── widgets/
149	    │   │           ├── audio_tab_view.dart                        # + Processando/Transcrito/Erro/SaveFailure sub-views
150	    │   │           ├── foto_tab_view.dart                         # + Processando OCR/Reconhecido/Erro (two actions)/SaveFailure sub-views, thumbnail
151	    │   │           └── capture_status_views.dart                  # CaptureFailureBand removed (superseded); new RecognitionErrorView added
152	    │   └── (entries/ unchanged — Entry, EntriesRepository, CreateEntryUseCase all reused as-is)
153	    └── core/di/service_locator.dart                              # registrations updated for the usecase/bloc-dependency changes above
154	```
155	
156	**Structure Decision**: Purely additive-and-corrective edits inside RF01's existing `capture`/`entries`
157	feature folders — no new top-level directory, no new feature. The one naming-level decision
158	(`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` replacing two near-duplicate per-modality usecases) is a consolidation, not a new
159	abstraction: once recognition moves out of each, `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` differ only
160	by a hardcoded `EntrySource` constant — data-model.md documents the merge.
161	
162	## Complexity Tracking
163	
164	*No entries — this unit adds no new dependency, no new feature folder, and no new kind of architectural
165	seam; its one consolidation (two usecases → one) reduces rather than adds complexity.*
166	
167	## Post-Design Constitution Check
168	
169	Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):
170	
171	- `RecognizePhotoUseCase`/`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` expose and consume only domain types (`OcrResult`,
172	  `Entry`, `EntrySource`, the two new local sealed failure types) — no `dio`/`image_picker`/`whisper_ggml`
173	  class crosses into `domain/`. RNF06/Principle V confirmed before any code exists.
174	- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` and `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` are called
175	  directly by `InsertionModalBloc` (no new usecase wrapping either), matching RF01's own established
176	  precedent of calling `AudioCaptureRepository`/`PhotoCaptureRepository` directly from the bloc for
177	  orchestration-free pass-throughs (data-model.md's rationale) — re-checked and found consistent, not a new
178	  kind of exception.
179	- The bloc's new "guard against a stale recognition result" rule (data-model.md: a `transcribe()`/
180	  `recognize()` result is only applied if the bloc's current state is still the matching `*Processing` state
181	  for the same held path) was re-checked against spec.md's Edge Case "no entry is created, regardless of how
182	  the in-flight recognition call eventually resolves" (User Story 5) and confirmed necessary — without it, a
183	  tab-switch-away-and-back during an in-flight call could apply a stale result to the wrong, newer state.
184	- No change surfaces that touches `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, any native iOS project file,
185	  F000's session/vault features, or any AI provider — Principle III remains intact.
186	
187	No new violations. Gate remains PASS.

Does this unit replace that RF01 behavior, or sit alongside it? → A: This unit replaces RF01's placeholder recognition UX for the audio and photo tabs with the dedicated states the prototype defines (`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.3, §4): "Processando"/"Transcrevendo" (spinner, frozen waveform), "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" (editable text, explicit "Salvar"), and "Erro" (retry, plus photo's extra "Salvar só a foto"). Concretely, stopping a recording or supplying an image no longer completes the save automatically — it starts recognition, and the user reviews (and may edit) the result before explicitly confirming "Salvar." The text-entry tab (no recognition involved) is unaffected and stays exactly as RF01 built it. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where RF01's own text names this unit as the owner of that deferred behavior.)

Does this unit now add confidence-aware handling to "Foto — Reconhecido," or continue ignoring it? → A: Continue ignoring it. 105	### Edge Cases
106	
107	- The editable text in "Transcrito" or "Reconhecido" is edited down to an empty or whitespace-only field: "Salvar" MUST become unavailable, since the backend requires non-empty entry content — the same empty-content guard RF01 applies to the "Texto" tab, now also applied here after edits.
108	- The device is offline when OCR would normally be attempted: "Foto — Processando OCR" MUST resolve to "Foto — Erro" with a clear, offline-appropriate message (not a generic failure) rather than hanging; "Salvar só a foto" and "Tentar novamente" remain visible, but "Salvar" (from a would-be "Reconhecido" state) and "Salvar só a foto" both still require connectivity for the underlying `POST /entries` call, following the same offline-blocks-writes rule established in RF01.
109	- Retrying OCR on an image that genuinely has no legible text (e.g., the illegible fixture) is still allowed via "Tentar novamente" even though the same result is likely; the system does not pre-emptively hide "Tentar novamente" based on whether the prior failure looked retryable.
110	- The app is backgrounded or killed while in "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro": nothing is lost that mattered, because nothing was persisted yet. 112	- "Tentar novamente" is tapped repeatedly in quick succession: only one recognition attempt runs at a time per capture; a repeat tap while an attempt is already in flight is ignored.
113	- A `low`-confidence OCR result that still contains text is treated identically to a `high`-confidence one: it reaches "Foto — Reconhecido" with no visual distinction, warning, or extra gating step — confidence-based quality handling remains out of scope for this unit, matching RF01's established treatment of the field.

119	- **FR-001**: When the user stops an audio recording (started in RF01's "Áudio" tab), the system MUST automatically begin on-device transcription and show "Áudio — Processando" — a spinner in place of the stop control, the waveform frozen and faded, the caption "Transcrevendo...", and the recorded duration — without creating any entry.
120	- **FR-002**: On successful transcription, the system MUST show "Áudio — Transcrito" with the transcribed text in an editable field, the original audio duration, and "Salvar" enabled; it MUST NOT create an entry until the user explicitly taps "Salvar", and the content saved MUST be the field's current text at the moment "Salvar" is tapped (reflecting any user edits).
121	- **FR-003**: If on-device transcription fails or produces no usable text, the system MUST show "Áudio — Erro" (warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente") and create no entry; tapping "Tentar novamente" MUST re-attempt transcription of the same already-held audio without requiring a new recording.
122	- **FR-004**: Audio content MUST NEVER be transmitted to the backend at any point in this flow — transcription runs entirely on-device via `whisper_ggml`, and only the resulting (possibly edited) text is ever sent over the network, inside the `POST /entries` call.
123	- **FR-005**: When the user supplies an image via the "Foto" tab (built in RF01), the system MUST automatically call the backend OCR endpoint (`POST /media/ocr`) and show "Foto — Processando OCR" — the photo thumbnail, a spinner, and the caption "Reconhecendo texto..." — without creating any entry.
124	- **FR-006**: On a successful OCR response with usable text, the system MUST show "Foto — Reconhecido" with the thumbnail next to the extracted text in an editable field and "Salvar" enabled; it MUST NOT create an entry until the user explicitly taps "Salvar", and the content saved MUST be the field's current text at that moment (reflecting any user edits). This applies identically regardless of the response's `confidence` value (`high` or `low`) — this unit adds no confidence-based gating, warning, or distinct review path, continuing RF01's established treatment of that field.
125	- **FR-007**: If the OCR call fails (including a no-usable-text result) the system MUST show "Foto — Erro" — thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto" — offering both "Tentar novamente" (re-attempts OCR on the same already-held image, without requiring a new capture) and "Salvar só a foto" (see FR-008), and create no entry until one of those two actions is taken.
126	- **FR-008**: Tapping "Salvar só a foto" MUST immediately create exactly one entry with origin "photo" and a fixed, non-empty placeholder string as its content (since the backend never persists the photo itself and requires non-empty entry content), without making any further OCR attempt for that capture.
127	- **FR-009**: In both "Transcrito" and "Reconhecido" states, "Salvar" MUST be unavailable whenever the editable text field is empty or whitespace-only, preventing an empty entry from being created through manual edits.
128	- **FR-010**: Confirming "Salvar" from "Transcrito" or "Reconhecido", or confirming "Salvar só a foto" from "Foto — Erro", MUST result in exactly one persisted entry via the entry-creation endpoint with the correct origin (`audio` or `photo`); the system MUST ignore any repeat trigger of that same action received while a save for that capture is already in flight, so at most one entry is ever created per confirmed capture.
129	- **FR-011**: If a capture is abandoned at any point while in "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro" — the modal is closed, the user navigates away, or the user switches tabs — the system MUST NOT create any entry, and MUST discard any in-progress recognition, recognized/transcribed text, and edits held for that capture.
130	- **FR-012**: This unit MUST NOT change the "Texto" tab's behavior (no recognition applies to typed text) and MUST NOT implement any functional behavior belonging to later-delivered requirements (the full behavior of RF04, RF05, RF06, RF07, RF08, RF09, RF10) or any extension feature (manual tags/categories, action plans, persona selection).
131	- **FR-013**: This unit MUST NOT modify the backend, its API contract, or its configuration in any way.
132	
133	### Key Entities
134	
135	- **Recognition Attempt**: Ephemeral, device-only state tracking one in-progress or completed transcription (audio) or OCR (photo) call for the capture currently open in the Insertion Modal — its status (processing, succeeded with text, failed), the resulting editable text (including user edits made before "Salvar"), and a reference to the still-locally-held audio/image it was run against. For photo, the OCR response's `confidence` value is carried through this state but never branched on (per the resolved Clarification above). It never itself becomes a persisted entry and is entirely discarded when the capture is abandoned or once "Salvar" successfully creates the entry.
136	- **Journal Entry** (extended from RF01): A persisted record with text content, an origin (`audio` or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time. For audio/photo, that content is now either the user-reviewed (and possibly edited) transcribed/recognized text, or — only via "Salvar só a foto" — a fixed placeholder string when no text was recognized. Structurally identical to entries from any other origin, and immutable once created.
137	
138	## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*
139	
140	### Measurable Outcomes
141	
142	- **SC-001**: 100% of audio captures whose on-device transcription succeeds reach the editable "Áudio — Transcrito" review state before any entry is created — none saves itself automatically.
143	- **SC-002**: 100% of photo captures whose OCR succeeds reach the editable "Foto — Reconhecido" review state before any entry is created — none saves itself automatically.
144	- **SC-003**: 100% of transcription or OCR failures leave the originally captured audio or image available for at least one retry attempt, without requiring the user to re-record or recapture.
145	- **SC-004**: 100% of OCR failures additionally offer a working path ("Salvar só a foto") to create an entry without recognized text, independent of whether a further OCR retry would succeed.
146	- **SC-005**: 0% of entries created through this unit's flows have empty or whitespace-only content, regardless of how the user edits the reviewed text beforehand.
147	- **SC-006**: 0% of captures abandoned during "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro" (for either modality) leave behind a persisted entry.
148	
149	## Assumptions
150	
151	- Per the resolved Clarification above, this unit supersedes RF01's FR-007 placeholder recognition UX for the "Áudio" and "Foto" tabs with the dedicated prototype states; the "Texto" tab is unaffected.
152	- The fixed placeholder content used by "Salvar só a foto" is a short, non-empty, Portuguese string signaling that the entry is a photo capture with no text recognized (exact wording left to implementation, since the prototype specifies only the triggering UI action, not the stored content, and the input documents are otherwise silent on it).
153	- "Tentar novamente" re-runs recognition against the same in-memory audio/image held since the original capture in RF01's modal — it never asks the user to re-record or reselect the source.
154	- Because entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`), the editable "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review is the only opportunity to correct a transcription/recognition mistake — there is no later in-app editing of a saved entry's content.
155	- The on-device transcription failure path (FR-003) is exercised in testing by forcing a transcription error (e.g., a corrupted or silent audio buffer), since the fixtures directory provides a reference success case (`audio_fixture_01.wav`) but no dedicated "untranscribable audio" fixture; OCR's failure path is exercised directly with the provided `ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png` fixture.
156	- "Salvar só a foto" and the OCR retry both still require network connectivity for their own calls (`POST /entries` and `POST /media/ocr` respectively), consistent with this product's cloud-only, no-offline-writes architecture already established in RF01 and RF06.
157	- Double-tap and repeat-trigger idempotency guards (FR-009, FR-010, and the "Tentar novamente" repeat-tap edge case) follow the same in-flight-action-is-ignored pattern RF01 already established for its own Save action.

# Feature Specification: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

**Feature Branch**: `004-stt-ocr-processing` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)

**Created**: 2026-10-13

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing: Turn captured audio into text on the device, and photos into text through the backend, before saving the entry. Requirement and acceptance criteria: docs/input/requirements.md, section 1, RF02. Prototype states: 'Áudio — Processando / Transcrito / Erro' and 'Foto — Processando OCR / Reconhecido / Erro' (prototype extract, sections 2.3 and 4). On-device speech-to-text with whisper_ggml (audio never goes to the backend); OCR with POST /media/ocr; then POST /entries. Test material: docs/input/backend/fixtures/. Depends on: RF01. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."

## Clarifications

### Session 2026-10-13

- Q: RF01's own specification (FR-007) deliberately stopped at a plain, generic loading indicator for audio/photo recognition and explicitly deferred "a dedicated multi-state screen..., an editable review step..., or modality-specific retry affordances" to "a later unit." Does this unit replace that RF01 behavior, or sit alongside it? → A: This unit replaces RF01's placeholder recognition UX for the audio and photo tabs with the dedicated states the prototype defines (`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.3, §4): "Processando"/"Transcrevendo" (spinner, frozen waveform), "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" (editable text, explicit "Salvar"), and "Erro" (retry, plus photo's extra "Salvar só a foto"). Concretely, stopping a recording or supplying an image no longer completes the save automatically — it starts recognition, and the user reviews (and may edit) the result before explicitly confirming "Salvar." The text-entry tab (no recognition involved) is unaffected and stays exactly as RF01 built it. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where RF01's own text names this unit as the owner of that deferred behavior.)
- Q: The prototype's "Foto — Erro" state offers "Salvar só a foto," which saves the record "even without extracted text" (§4). The backend never persists the photo itself (`POST /media/ocr` summary: "the image is never persisted") and `POST /entries` requires `content` with `minLength: 1` — so what content does that saved entry actually carry? → A: A fixed, non-empty placeholder string (not the empty string, which the backend contract forbids) is sent as `content`, with `source: "photo"`; no later OCR attempt is made for that capture once this action is taken. This is the only reading consistent with the frozen `POST /entries` contract, which has no field for an unrecognized image and no way to accept empty content. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs specify the UI affordance but not the entry's stored content.)
- Q: `POST /media/ocr`'s success response always carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text. RF01's own spec explicitly deferred any confidence-based quality gating to this unit ("confidence-based quality gating is out of scope for this unit — reserved for RF02") while carrying the field through unused. Does this unit now add confidence-aware handling to "Foto — Reconhecido," or continue ignoring it? → A: Continue ignoring it. Any non-empty OCR text — `high` or `low` confidence alike — reaches "Foto — Reconhecido" identically, with no visual distinction, warning, or separate review path keyed to confidence. The prototype's "Foto — Reconhecido" row (§2.3) defines no confidence-related element, so adding one here would invent a UI state the prototype never specifies; this also keeps the field's treatment consistent with RF01's own precedent. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Reviewing and saving a transcribed audio entry (Priority: P1)

A user finishes recording in the "Áudio" tab (built in RF01). Instead of the entry saving itself right away, the app shows it is transcribing, then presents the transcribed text for the user to read — and optionally correct — before they explicitly tap "Salvar" to create the entry.

**Why this priority**: This is RF02's core deliverable for audio — the dedicated processing/review states the prototype defines, replacing RF01's placeholder "automatic save behind a generic spinner" behavior for this modality.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by recording a short note using the audio fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav`, reference text in `expected-transcription.md`), stopping, observing the "Processando" state, confirming the "Transcrito" state shows that text editable with "Salvar" enabled, optionally editing it, tapping "Salvar," and confirming one new entry exists with origin "audio" and exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text as content.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the user has just stopped an audio recording, **When** that happens, **Then** the app automatically begins on-device transcription and shows "Áudio — Processando": a spinner in place of the stop control, the waveform frozen and faded, the text "Transcrevendo...", and the recorded duration — with no entry created yet.
2. **Given** transcription completes successfully, **When** that happens, **Then** the app shows "Áudio — Transcrito": the transcribed text in an editable field, the original audio duration shown, and "Salvar" enabled — still with no entry created.
3. **Given** the "Áudio — Transcrito" state with the transcribed text unedited, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** exactly one entry is created with origin "audio" and that exact text as content.
4. **Given** the "Áudio — Transcrito" state, **When** the user edits the text before tapping "Salvar", **Then** the entry created on "Salvar" carries the edited text, not the original transcription.
5. **Given** transcription is on-device, **When** any part of this flow runs, **Then** the recorded audio is never sent to the backend — only the final (possibly edited) text leaves the device, inside the `POST /entries` call.

---

### User Story 2 - Recovering from a failed transcription (Priority: P1)

A recording is too noisy, too quiet, or otherwise fails to transcribe. The user is told clearly and can retry without re-recording, since the audio is still held.

**Why this priority**: Mirrors Story 1's happy path with the failure branch the prototype explicitly requires ("Áudio — Erro"); pairs with it as the complete audio pipeline.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by forcing an on-device transcription failure (e.g., a silent or corrupted audio capture) after stopping a recording, confirming "Áudio — Erro" appears with "Tentar novamente" and no entry is created, then tapping "Tentar novamente" and confirming the same held audio is retried (no new recording required).

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** on-device transcription fails or returns no usable text, **When** that happens, **Then** the app shows "Áudio — Erro": a red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", and an outline button "Tentar novamente" — and no entry is created.
2. **Given** "Áudio — Erro" is showing, **When** the user taps "Tentar novamente", **Then** the system re-attempts transcription of the same already-held audio, without requiring a new recording, moving back to "Áudio — Processando".
3. **Given** "Áudio — Erro" is showing, **When** the user closes the modal, switches tabs, or navigates away instead of retrying, **Then** no entry is created and the held audio and error state are discarded.

---

### User Story 3 - Reviewing and saving a recognized photo entry (Priority: P2)

A user supplies an image in the "Foto" tab (built in RF01). The app sends it to the backend for OCR, shows that it is recognizing text, then presents the recognized text next to a thumbnail for the user to read — and optionally correct — before they explicitly tap "Salvar."

**Why this priority**: The photo counterpart of Story 1; ordered after the audio pair because it shares the same reviewed-recognition pattern, just backed by the backend OCR call instead of on-device transcription.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by supplying the legible-text fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/ocr_fixture_01.png`), observing "Foto — Processando OCR", confirming "Foto — Reconhecido" shows the extracted text editable next to a thumbnail with "Salvar" enabled, optionally editing it, tapping "Salvar," and confirming one new entry exists with origin "photo" and exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text as content.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the user has just supplied an image (camera or gallery), **When** that happens, **Then** the app automatically calls the OCR endpoint and shows "Foto — Processando OCR": the photo thumbnail, a spinner, and "Reconhecendo texto..." — with no entry created yet.
2. **Given** OCR completes successfully with usable text, **When** that happens, **Then** the app shows "Foto — Reconhecido": the thumbnail next to the extracted text in an editable field, and "Salvar" enabled — still with no entry created.
3. **Given** the "Foto — Reconhecido" state, **When** the user taps "Salvar" (with or without edits), **Then** exactly one entry is created with origin "photo" and the current (possibly edited) text as content.
4. **Given** OCR is backend-driven, **When** any part of this flow runs, **Then** the image itself is never persisted by the backend — only its extracted text is used, consistent with the `POST /media/ocr` contract.

---

### User Story 4 - Recovering from a failed photo recognition (Priority: P2)

An image has no legible text, or the OCR call otherwise fails. The user is told clearly and has two ways forward: retry recognition on the same image, or save the entry anyway without any recognized text.

**Why this priority**: The photo failure path is explicitly richer than audio's (two recovery actions instead of one), so it is scoped as its own story even though it parallels Story 2.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by supplying the illegible-text fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png`), confirming "Foto — Erro" appears with both "Tentar novamente" and "Salvar só a foto" and no entry is created yet, then separately verifying (a) "Tentar novamente" re-runs OCR on the same held image, and (b) "Salvar só a foto" creates exactly one entry with origin "photo" and non-empty placeholder content, without a further OCR attempt.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** OCR fails, times out, or returns no usable text, **When** that happens, **Then** the app shows "Foto — Erro": the thumbnail kept on screen, a red warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", the button "Tentar novamente", and the secondary text action "Salvar só a foto" — and no entry is created yet.
2. **Given** "Foto — Erro" is showing, **When** the user taps "Tentar novamente", **Then** the system re-attempts OCR on the same already-held image, without requiring a new capture, moving back to "Foto — Processando OCR".
3. **Given** "Foto — Erro" is showing, **When** the user taps "Salvar só a foto" instead, **Then** exactly one entry is created immediately with origin "photo" and a fixed, non-empty placeholder as its content, and no further OCR call is made for that capture.
4. **Given** "Foto — Erro" is showing, **When** the user closes the modal, switches tabs, or navigates away instead of choosing either action, **Then** no entry is created and the held image and error state are discarded.

---

### User Story 5 - Abandoning mid-recognition or mid-review leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)

A user starts the transcription/recognition flow for audio or photo and backs out before ever tapping "Salvar" — whether recognition is still running, succeeded and is sitting in the editable review, or failed.

**Why this priority**: A safety property spanning both new recognition pipelines rather than a feature of its own; depends on Stories 1–4 already existing to have intermediate states to abandon from.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by triggering each of "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", and "Erro" for both audio and photo, closing the modal or navigating away from each without tapping "Salvar" or "Salvar só a foto", and confirming no entry was created in any case.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** audio transcription or photo OCR is in progress ("Processando"/"Transcrevendo" or "Processando OCR"), **When** the user closes the modal or navigates away, **Then** no entry is created, regardless of how the in-flight recognition call eventually resolves.
2. **Given** the editable "Transcrito" or "Reconhecido" review state, possibly with unsaved edits, **When** the user closes the modal or navigates away without tapping "Salvar", **Then** no entry is created and the edited text is discarded.
3. **Given** the user switches tabs while any of these states is active, **When** that happens, **Then** the in-progress or completed-but-unsaved recognition is discarded, the same as closing the modal.

---

### Edge Cases

- The editable text in "Transcrito" or "Reconhecido" is edited down to an empty or whitespace-only field: "Salvar" MUST become unavailable, since the backend requires non-empty entry content — the same empty-content guard RF01 applies to the "Texto" tab, now also applied here after edits.
- The device is offline when OCR would normally be attempted: "Foto — Processando OCR" MUST resolve to "Foto — Erro" with a clear, offline-appropriate message (not a generic failure) rather than hanging; "Salvar só a foto" and "Tentar novamente" remain visible, but "Salvar" (from a would-be "Reconhecido" state) and "Salvar só a foto" both still require connectivity for the underlying `POST /entries` call, following the same offline-blocks-writes rule established in RF01.
- Retrying OCR on an image that genuinely has no legible text (e.g., the illegible fixture) is still allowed via "Tentar novamente" even though the same result is likely; the system does not pre-emptively hide "Tentar novamente" based on whether the prior failure looked retryable.
- The app is backgrounded or killed while in "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro": nothing is lost that mattered, because nothing was persisted yet. On return after a mere backgrounding, the state resumes normally (including any unsaved edits); after a process kill, the modal reopens to its default empty state and the user must recapture, the same lifecycle rule RF01 established for its own in-progress states, now extended to these additional ones.
- The user double-taps "Salvar" (from "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") or double-taps "Salvar só a foto": only one entry is ever created per confirmed capture, never duplicates — the system ignores a repeat trigger received while a save for that capture is already in flight.
- "Tentar novamente" is tapped repeatedly in quick succession: only one recognition attempt runs at a time per capture; a repeat tap while an attempt is already in flight is ignored.
- A `low`-confidence OCR result that still contains text is treated identically to a `high`-confidence one: it reaches "Foto — Reconhecido" with no visual distinction, warning, or extra gating step — confidence-based quality handling remains out of scope for this unit, matching RF01's established treatment of the field.

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-001**: When the user stops an audio recording (started in RF01's "Áudio" tab), the system MUST automatically begin on-device transcription and show "Áudio — Processando" — a spinner in place of the stop control, the waveform frozen and faded, the caption "Transcrevendo...", and the recorded duration — without creating any entry.
- **FR-002**: On successful transcription, the system MUST show "Áudio — Transcrito" with the transcribed text in an editable field, the original audio duration, and "Salvar" enabled; it MUST NOT create an entry until the user explicitly taps "Salvar", and the content saved MUST be the field's current text at the moment "Salvar" is tapped (reflecting any user edits).
- **FR-003**: If on-device transcription fails or produces no usable text, the system MUST show "Áudio — Erro" (warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente") and create no entry; tapping "Tentar novamente" MUST re-attempt transcription of the same already-held audio without requiring a new recording.
- **FR-004**: Audio content MUST NEVER be transmitted to the backend at any point in this flow — transcription runs entirely on-device via `whisper_ggml`, and only the resulting (possibly edited) text is ever sent over the network, inside the `POST /entries` call.
- **FR-005**: When the user supplies an image via the "Foto" tab (built in RF01), the system MUST automatically call the backend OCR endpoint (`POST /media/ocr`) and show "Foto — Processando OCR" — the photo thumbnail, a spinner, and the caption "Reconhecendo texto..." — without creating any entry.
- **FR-006**: On a successful OCR response with usable text, the system MUST show "Foto — Reconhecido" with the thumbnail next to the extracted text in an editable field and "Salvar" enabled; it MUST NOT create an entry until the user explicitly taps "Salvar", and the content saved MUST be the field's current text at that moment (reflecting any user edits). This applies identically regardless of the response's `confidence` value (`high` or `low`) — this unit adds no confidence-based gating, warning, or distinct review path, continuing RF01's established treatment of that field.
- **FR-007**: If the OCR call fails (including a no-usable-text result) the system MUST show "Foto — Erro" — thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto" — offering both "Tentar novamente" (re-attempts OCR on the same already-held image, without requiring a new capture) and "Salvar só a foto" (see FR-008), and create no entry until one of those two actions is taken.
- **FR-008**: Tapping "Salvar só a foto" MUST immediately create exactly one entry with origin "photo" and a fixed, non-empty placeholder string as its content (since the backend never persists the photo itself and requires non-empty entry content), without making any further OCR attempt for that capture.
- **FR-009**: In both "Transcrito" and "Reconhecido" states, "Salvar" MUST be unavailable whenever the editable text field is empty or whitespace-only, preventing an empty entry from being created through manual edits.
- **FR-010**: Confirming "Salvar" from "Transcrito" or "Reconhecido", or confirming "Salvar só a foto" from "Foto — Erro", MUST result in exactly one persisted entry via the entry-creation endpoint with the correct origin (`audio` or `photo`); the system MUST ignore any repeat trigger of that same action received while a save for that capture is already in flight, so at most one entry is ever created per confirmed capture.
- **FR-011**: If a capture is abandoned at any point while in "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro" — the modal is closed, the user navigates away, or the user switches tabs — the system MUST NOT create any entry, and MUST discard any in-progress recognition, recognized/transcribed text, and edits held for that capture.
- **FR-012**: This unit MUST NOT change the "Texto" tab's behavior (no recognition applies to typed text) and MUST NOT implement any functional behavior belonging to later-delivered requirements (the full behavior of RF04, RF05, RF06, RF07, RF08, RF09, RF10) or any extension feature (manual tags/categories, action plans, persona selection).
- **FR-013**: This unit MUST NOT modify the backend, its API contract, or its configuration in any way.

### Key Entities

- **Recognition Attempt**: Ephemeral, device-only state tracking one in-progress or completed transcription (audio) or OCR (photo) call for the capture currently open in the Insertion Modal — its status (processing, succeeded with text, failed), the resulting editable text (including user edits made before "Salvar"), and a reference to the still-locally-held audio/image it was run against. For photo, the OCR response's `confidence` value is carried through this state but never branched on (per the resolved Clarification above). It never itself becomes a persisted entry and is entirely discarded when the capture is abandoned or once "Salvar" successfully creates the entry.
- **Journal Entry** (extended from RF01): A persisted record with text content, an origin (`audio` or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time. For audio/photo, that content is now either the user-reviewed (and possibly edited) transcribed/recognized text, or — only via "Salvar só a foto" — a fixed placeholder string when no text was recognized. Structurally identical to entries from any other origin, and immutable once created.

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

### Measurable Outcomes

- **SC-001**: 100% of audio captures whose on-device transcription succeeds reach the editable "Áudio — Transcrito" review state before any entry is created — none saves itself automatically.
- **SC-002**: 100% of photo captures whose OCR succeeds reach the editable "Foto — Reconhecido" review state before any entry is created — none saves itself automatically.
- **SC-003**: 100% of transcription or OCR failures leave the originally captured audio or image available for at least one retry attempt, without requiring the user to re-record or recapture.
- **SC-004**: 100% of OCR failures additionally offer a working path ("Salvar só a foto") to create an entry without recognized text, independent of whether a further OCR retry would succeed.
- **SC-005**: 0% of entries created through this unit's flows have empty or whitespace-only content, regardless of how the user edits the reviewed text beforehand.
- **SC-006**: 0% of captures abandoned during "Processando"/"Transcrevendo", "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido", or "Erro" (for either modality) leave behind a persisted entry.

## Assumptions

- Per the resolved Clarification above, this unit supersedes RF01's FR-007 placeholder recognition UX for the "Áudio" and "Foto" tabs with the dedicated prototype states; the "Texto" tab is unaffected.
- The fixed placeholder content used by "Salvar só a foto" is a short, non-empty, Portuguese string signaling that the entry is a photo capture with no text recognized (exact wording left to implementation, since the prototype specifies only the triggering UI action, not the stored content, and the input documents are otherwise silent on it).
- "Tentar novamente" re-runs recognition against the same in-memory audio/image held since the original capture in RF01's modal — it never asks the user to re-record or reselect the source.
- Because entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`), the editable "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review is the only opportunity to correct a transcription/recognition mistake — there is no later in-app editing of a saved entry's content.
- The on-device transcription failure path (FR-003) is exercised in testing by forcing a transcription error (e.g., a corrupted or silent audio buffer), since the fixtures directory provides a reference success case (`audio_fixture_01.wav`) but no dedicated "untranscribable audio" fixture; OCR's failure path is exercised directly with the provided `ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png` fixture.
- "Salvar só a foto" and the OCR retry both still require network connectivity for their own calls (`POST /entries` and `POST /media/ocr` respectively), consistent with this product's cloud-only, no-offline-writes architecture already established in RF01 and RF06.
- Double-tap and repeat-trigger idempotency guards (FR-009, FR-010, and the "Tentar novamente" repeat-tap edge case) follow the same in-flight-action-is-ignored pattern RF01 already established for its own Save action.

1	# Data Model: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

this lives entirely in `InsertionModalBloc`'s own state plus bloc-private fields — no other layer sees it.

## `RecognizePhotoUseCase` (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/recognize_photo_usecase.dart` — NEW)

```dart
sealed class PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
class PhotoRecognitionOffline extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
class PhotoRecognitionCallFailed extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure { final Failure failure; }

class RecognizePhotoUseCase {
  Future<Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>> call(String imageFilePath) async {

      (failure) => Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(failure)),
```

```dart
    final created = await createEntryUseCase(content, source);
    return created.match(
      (failure) => Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(failure)),
```

```
                -> _photoReviewText = ocrResult.text; InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text)  # FR-006 — no entry yet

  PhotoReviewTextChanged(text) (from InsertionModalFotoReconhecido | InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure)
    -> _photoReviewText = text; re-emit the same state class with the updated text

  PhotoSaveConfirmed (from InsertionModalFotoReconhecido | InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure; text non-empty, not already saving)
    -> InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoReviewText)
        ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoReviewText, EntrySource.photo)
            Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes                           (FR-010)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())        -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, text, offlineMessage)
            Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f)) -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, text, f.message)

  PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure; no further OCR attempt — FR-008)
    -> InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder)
        ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoNoTextPlaceholder, EntrySource.photo)
            Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
            Left(...) -> InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder, message)

    -> InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path); re-run the recognize branch above against the same path   (FR-007)

    -> _pendingImagePath = null; _photoReviewText = null; target state emitted (or bloc disposed)     (FR-011)
```

| Type | Return type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `RecognizePhotoUseCase.call()` | `Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>` | `PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure` is a new, small local sealed type distinguishing "never called `media-ocr`" (offline) from "the call itself failed" (wraps the existing, unmodified `Failure`) — same shape of decision RF01's research.md R7 (specs/003) already made for its own local-only types. |

unaffected by this unit (still 6/15, cumulative from RF01 — plan.md's Constitution Check).

```dart

static const double sizeStatusIcon = 32;
```

for the outline "Tentar novamente" button, the existing type scale for "Transcrevendo..."/"Reconhecendo
texto..." captions, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator` for the spinner, `Opacity(0.35)` for

# Quickstart: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's five user stories. A run guide,
not an implementation spec — interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in `data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- RF01 already implemented and passing (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/`) — this unit edits, not replaces, its
  Insertion Modal, repositories, and data sources. No new package, no new native-project change, no new `.env`
  variable beyond what RF01 already required.
- The backend fixtures this unit specifically exercises:
  `docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav` (reference transcript in
  `expected-transcription.md`), `media/ocr_fixture_01.png` (legible text → "Foto — Reconhecido"),
  `media/ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png` (illegible → "Foto — Erro"). Audio's own failure path has no dedicated
  fixture (spec.md Assumptions) — force it with a silent or corrupted recording instead.

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint (unchanged convention)
fvm flutter test --coverage
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html   # RNF07 gate — now covering recognize_photo_usecase.dart + confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart in place of the two deleted usecases
```

Key domain/bloc tests this unit's coverage depends on — contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md's table
has the full scenario list for `RecognizePhotoUseCase`, `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, and `InsertionModalBloc`.
`AudioTranscriptionRepositoryImpl`/`PhotoRecognitionRepositoryImpl` tests are unchanged from RF01 (the
repositories themselves are untouched).

## Manual verification (device/Simulator — `whisper_ggml`/`image_picker` have no platform channel under `flutter_test`)

### Story 1 — Reviewing and saving a transcribed audio entry (P1)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Áudio", tap the start control, speak a short phrase, tap stop. **Expect**: "Áudio —
   Processando" — a spinner in place of the stop control, the waveform frozen and faded, "Transcrevendo...",
   the recorded duration — and the modal does **not** close yet.
2. Once transcription finishes. **Expect**: "Áudio — Transcrito" — the transcribed text in an editable
   field, the same duration, "Salvar" enabled. Still no entry created (check via a debug log/backend-side
   check that no `entries-create` call has happened yet).
3. Edit the text, tap "Salvar". **Expect**: exactly one entry created with `source: "audio"` and the *edited*
   text, not the original transcription; modal closes.
4. Repeat using `audio_fixture_01.wav` played into the Simulator's mic and compare the "Transcrito" text
   against `expected-transcription.md` before saving.
5. Confirm via a debug log that at no point during steps 1–3 was any network call made carrying audio bytes
   (FR-004) — only the final `entries-create` call, carrying text.

### Story 2 — Recovering from a failed transcription (P1)

1. Force a transcription failure (e.g., a silent or corrupted recording), stop. **Expect**: "Áudio — Erro" —
   red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline "Tentar novamente" — no entry created.
2. Tap "Tentar novamente". **Expect**: back to "Áudio — Processando" against the *same* held audio — no new
   recording prompt.
3. From "Áudio — Erro", close the modal instead of retrying. **Expect**: no entry created, held audio
   discarded (confirm by reopening "+" → Áudio shows the idle "Toque para gravar" state, not a resumed Erro).

### Story 3 — Reviewing and saving a recognized photo entry (P2)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Foto", tap "Galeria", pick `ocr_fixture_01.png`. **Expect**: "Foto — Processando OCR"
   — thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto..." — no entry yet.
2. Once OCR finishes. **Expect**: "Foto — Reconhecido" — the thumbnail next to the extracted editable text,
   "Salvar" enabled. Still no entry created.
3. Optionally edit the text, tap "Salvar". **Expect**: exactly one entry with `source: "photo"` and the
   current (possibly edited) text; modal closes.
4. Confirm via a debug log/backend-side check that the image itself was never persisted — only the one
   `media-ocr` call (with the base64 image) and the final `entries-create` call (text only) happened.

### Story 4 — Recovering from a failed photo recognition (P2)

1. Pick `ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png`. **Expect**: "Foto — Erro" — thumbnail kept, red warning icon, "Não foi
   possível reconhecer o texto", "Tentar novamente" and the secondary text action "Salvar só a foto" — no
   entry created yet.
2. Tap "Tentar novamente". **Expect**: back to "Foto — Processando OCR" against the same held image — no new
   picker call.
3. From "Foto — Erro" again, tap "Salvar só a foto" instead. **Expect**: exactly one entry created
   immediately with `source: "photo"` and the fixed placeholder content (non-empty) — confirm via a debug log
   that **no** further `media-ocr` call was made for this capture.
4. From a fresh "Foto — Erro", close the modal instead of choosing either action. **Expect**: no entry
   created, held image discarded.

### Story 5 — Abandoning mid-recognition or mid-review leaves nothing behind (P3)

1. Start a recording, stop it, and while "Áudio — Processando" is showing, immediately switch to "Foto".
   **Expect**: no entry created even once the (now-abandoned) transcription eventually resolves in the
   background — confirm via a debug log that no late `entries-create` call ever fires, and that returning to
   "Áudio" shows the idle state, not a stale "Transcrito"/"Erro".
2. Reach "Áudio — Transcrito", edit the text, then close the modal without tapping "Salvar". **Expect**: no
   entry created; reopening "+" shows a fresh, empty Áudio idle state.
3. Reach "Foto — Reconhecido", then switch to "Texto" instead of saving. **Expect**: no entry created; the
   picked image/recognized text is discarded (returning to "Foto" shows the two-button Captura state, not a
   resumed Reconhecido).

### Edge cases worth exercising manually at least once

- Edit "Áudio — Transcrito"'s or "Foto — Reconhecido"'s text down to only whitespace. **Expect**: "Salvar"
  becomes disabled immediately (<100 ms, RNF01) — confirm no entry can be created this way.

  texto") — confirm via a network log that no `media-ocr` call was even attempted.

  "Áudio — Transcrito" normally) — only the subsequent "Salvar" should be blocked by airplane mode, with its
  own offline message, keeping the transcribed text on screen for a retry once reconnected.
- Double-tap "Salvar" (from Transcrito/Reconhecido) and double-tap "Salvar só a foto" on a slow connection.
  **Expect**: exactly one entry each, never two.
- Tap "Tentar novamente" repeatedly in quick succession. **Expect**: only one recognition attempt runs; the
  repeat taps are no-ops (the state is already `*Processing`, not `*Failure`, once the first tap lands).
- Background the app (Simulator: Cmd+Shift+H) while "Áudio — Transcrito" is showing with unsaved edits, then
  foreground it again. **Expect**: the edited text and state resume normally (mere backgrounding, not a
  process kill). Force-kill and relaunch instead. **Expect**: cold launch re-enters via splash → vault →

40	## Handler changes
41	
42	- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the ticker, calls
43	  `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` for the path (stored in `_pendingAudioPath`), captures the final `elapsed`
44	  as `duration`, and emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` — **no connectivity check** (research.md
45	  R1). It then awaits `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path)` directly (no usecase wrapper — the
46	  repository call has no orchestration left to add). Before applying the result, it checks `state is
47	  InsertionModalAudioProcessing && _pendingAudioPath == path`; if that no longer holds (the user switched
48	  tabs/closed the modal meanwhile), the result is discarded (research.md R6). Otherwise:
49	  `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())`/`Left(TranscriptionError())` map to `InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration,
50	  message)` (data-model.md's message table, unchanged from RF01's `_audioFailureMessage` minus its
51	  entry-creation branch); `Right(text)` sets `_audioReviewText = text` and emits
52	  `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)` — **no entry created**.
53	- **`AudioReviewTextChanged(text)`** (from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` or
54	  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`): sets `_audioReviewText = text` and re-emits the same state subtype with
55	  the updated text, same `duration`/other fields held.

57	  state is InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`, and `_audioReviewText` is non-empty/non-whitespace — mirrors the
58	  Texto tab's own "Salvar" guard): emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)`, awaits

60	  and triggers the existing one-shot `closeRequests` side effect (unchanged from RF01 — the page pops the
61	  sheet). `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` map to
62	  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(_audioReviewText, duration, message)` — the audio file and reviewed text
63	  both stay held; a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` is the retry (research.md R5).
64	- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if a save/recognition is already in flight for this tab): calls
65	  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` (cancelled) stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`; a path
66	  is stored in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)`, then awaits
67	  `RecognizePhotoUseCase(path)` (this one *does* go through a usecase — it still has the connectivity gate to
68	  perform, research.md R1 vs. audio). Same stale-result guard as audio (`state is InsertionModalFotoProcessing
69	  && _pendingImagePath == path`) before applying the result. `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` maps to
70	  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, offlineMessage)`; `Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f))` maps to
71	  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, message)` using the same `f is OcrNoTextFailure ? noTextMessage :
72	  f.message` branch RF01's `_photoFailureMessage` already used. `Right(ocrResult)` sets `_photoReviewText =
73	  ocrResult.text` and emits `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text)` — confidence read but never
74	  branched on (Clarification 3).
75	- **`PhotoReviewTextChanged(text)`**: same shape as the audio equivalent, for `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido`/
76	  `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`.
77	- **`PhotoSaveConfirmed`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoReconhecido ||
78	  state is InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`, text non-empty): same shape as `AudioSaveConfirmed`, with
79	  `EntrySource.photo` and `InsertionModalFotoSaving`/`InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure` in place of the audio
80	  states.
81	- **`PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoFailure`): emits
82	  `InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder)` directly — **no further OCR call** (FR-008) —
83	  then awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoNoTextPlaceholder, EntrySource.photo)` with the same
84	  success/failure mapping as `PhotoSaveConfirmed`.

86	  `AudioStopRequested` handler's transcription branch (emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` first)
87	  against the same path — no new recording. From `InsertionModalFotoFailure` (with `_pendingImagePath !=
88	  null`), re-enters the `PhotoSourceSelected` handler's recognition branch (emits
89	  `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)` first) against the same path — no new picker call. A repeat
90	  `RetryRequested` while already `*Processing` is a no-op (the guard above already excludes it, since
91	  `*Processing` isn't `*Failure`).
92	- **`TabSelected(<anything>)`** while any Áudio sub-state beyond `Idle`/`Recording` (i.e., `Processing`,
93	  `Transcribed`, `Saving`, `SaveFailure`, `Failure`): clears `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText` before

```dart
class AudioReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class AudioSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoReviewTextChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class PhotoSaveConfirmed extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
// TabSelected, TextDraftChanged, SaveTextSubmitted, AudioTimerTicked, AudioStartRequested,
// AudioStopRequested, PhotoSourceSelected, RetryRequested, ModalClosed — all reused unchanged in shape.
```

## Handler changes

- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the ticker, calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` for the path (stored in `_pendingAudioPath`), captures the final `elapsed`
  as `duration`, and emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` — **no connectivity check** (research.md
  R1). It then awaits `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path)` directly (no usecase wrapper — the
  repository call has no orchestration left to add). Before applying the result, it checks `state is
  InsertionModalAudioProcessing && _pendingAudioPath == path`; if that no longer holds (the user switched
  tabs/closed the modal meanwhile), the result is discarded (research.md R6). Otherwise:
  `Left(EmptyRecognitionResult())`/`Left(TranscriptionError())` map to `InsertionModalAudioFailure(duration,
  message)` (data-model.md's message table, unchanged from RF01's `_audioFailureMessage` minus its
  entry-creation branch); `Right(text)` sets `_audioReviewText = text` and emits
  `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed(text, duration)` — **no entry created**.
- **`AudioReviewTextChanged(text)`** (from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` or
  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`): sets `_audioReviewText = text` and re-emits the same state subtype with
  the updated text, same `duration`/other fields held.
- **`AudioSaveConfirmed`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioTranscribed ||
  state is InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`, and `_audioReviewText` is non-empty/non-whitespace — mirrors the
  Texto tab's own "Salvar" guard): emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)`, awaits
  `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_audioReviewText, EntrySource.audio)`. `Right(entry)` clears `_pendingAudioPath`
  and triggers the existing one-shot `closeRequests` side effect (unchanged from RF01 — the page pops the
  sheet). `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` map to
  `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(_audioReviewText, duration, message)` — the audio file and reviewed text
  both stay held; a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` is the retry (research.md R5).
- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if a save/recognition is already in flight for this tab): calls
  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` (cancelled) stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`; a path
  is stored in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)`, then awaits
  `RecognizePhotoUseCase(path)` (this one *does* go through a usecase — it still has the connectivity gate to
  perform, research.md R1 vs. audio). Same stale-result guard as audio (`state is InsertionModalFotoProcessing
  && _pendingImagePath == path`) before applying the result. `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` maps to
  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, offlineMessage)`; `Left(PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(f))` maps to
  `InsertionModalFotoFailure(path, message)` using the same `f is OcrNoTextFailure ? noTextMessage :
  f.message` branch RF01's `_photoFailureMessage` already used. `Right(ocrResult)` sets `_photoReviewText =
  ocrResult.text` and emits `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido(path, ocrResult.text)` — confidence read but never
  branched on (Clarification 3).
- **`PhotoReviewTextChanged(text)`**: same shape as the audio equivalent, for `InsertionModalFotoReconhecido`/
  `InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`.
- **`PhotoSaveConfirmed`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoReconhecido ||
  state is InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure`, text non-empty): same shape as `AudioSaveConfirmed`, with
  `EntrySource.photo` and `InsertionModalFotoSaving`/`InsertionModalFotoSaveFailure` in place of the audio
  states.
- **`PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalFotoFailure`): emits
  `InsertionModalFotoSaving(path, _photoNoTextPlaceholder)` directly — **no further OCR call** (FR-008) —
  then awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_photoNoTextPlaceholder, EntrySource.photo)` with the same
  success/failure mapping as `PhotoSaveConfirmed`.
- **`RetryRequested`**: from `InsertionModalAudioFailure` (with `_pendingAudioPath != null`), re-enters the
  `AudioStopRequested` handler's transcription branch (emits `InsertionModalAudioProcessing(duration)` first)
  against the same path — no new recording. From `InsertionModalFotoFailure` (with `_pendingImagePath !=
  null`), re-enters the `PhotoSourceSelected` handler's recognition branch (emits
  `InsertionModalFotoProcessing(path)` first) against the same path — no new picker call. A repeat
  `RetryRequested` while already `*Processing` is a no-op (the guard above already excludes it, since
  `*Processing` isn't `*Failure`).
- **`TabSelected(<anything>)`** while any Áudio sub-state beyond `Idle`/`Recording` (i.e., `Processing`,
  `Transcribed`, `Saving`, `SaveFailure`, `Failure`): clears `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText` before
  emitting the target tab's state — any in-flight or completed-but-unreviewed recognition is abandoned
  (FR-011). Same for Foto's equivalent sub-states and `_pendingImagePath`/`_photoReviewText`. The existing
  mid-`Recording` discard (`AudioCaptureRepository.discard()`) is unchanged.
- **`ModalClosed`**: extends RF01's existing "discard an in-progress recording" behavior to also clear
  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_audioReviewText`/`_pendingImagePath`/`_photoReviewText` unconditionally — nothing
  from an abandoned recognition/review survives disposal (FR-011), matching the `close()` override's own
  existing fallback path for the swipe-down/tap-outside dismissal case.

## Who depends on this

`AudioTabView` renders `InsertionModalAudioProcessing` (spinner in place of the stop control + `Opacity(0.35)`
around the existing `AudioWaveform` + "Transcrevendo..." + `duration`), `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` (an
editable `TextFormField` seeded from `text`, `duration` in `DesignTokens.textMonoCaption`, "Salvar" enabled
iff the field is non-empty/non-whitespace), `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure` (the same editable field plus an
inline `colorError` message, "Salvar" still enabled), and `InsertionModalAudioFailure` (the new
`RecognitionErrorView`, one action). `FotoTabView` renders the equivalent four Foto states, each additionally
showing an `Image.file(File(imagePath))` thumbnail at `DesignTokens.sizePhotoThumbnail`, and
`InsertionModalFotoFailure`'s `RecognitionErrorView` with its second action, "Salvar só a foto"
(`PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested`). `InsertionModalPage`'s `_tabOf` switch is extended with the new state
cases, same exhaustive-pattern-match convention as RF01.
