1	# Contract: Recognition and save usecases (`lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/`) — RF02 changes
2	
3	RF01's `SaveTextEntryUseCase` is untouched (Texto has no recognition step, FR-012). This document covers the
4	two usecases this unit adds/replaces; data-model.md has their full bodies.
5	
6	## `RecognizePhotoUseCase` (NEW)
7	
8	```dart
9	class RecognizePhotoUseCase {
10	  const RecognizePhotoUseCase({
11	    required PhotoRecognitionRepository recognitionRepository,
12	    required ConnectivityChecker connectivityChecker,
13	  });
14	
15	  Future<Either<PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure, OcrResult>> call(String imageFilePath);
16	}
17	
18	sealed class PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
19	class PhotoRecognitionOffline extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {}
20	class PhotoRecognitionCallFailed extends PhotoRecognitionAttemptFailure {
21	  const PhotoRecognitionCallFailed(this.failure);
22	  final Failure failure;
23	}
24	```
25	
26	- **Preconditions**: none — callable any number of times against the same `imageFilePath` (used by both the
27	  initial automatic call on image selection and every "Tentar novamente").
28	- **Behavior**: checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first; `false` short-circuits to
29	  `Left(PhotoRecognitionOffline())` without calling `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` at all (same
30	  "don't even attempt a call that cannot succeed" principle RF01's research.md R5 established, now scoped to
31	  this one call instead of the old combined flow). Otherwise delegates to
32	  `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(imageFilePath)` unchanged and wraps its `Left`/`Right` in
33	  `PhotoRecognitionCallFailed`/`Right` respectively.
34	- **Does not** call `CreateEntryUseCase` or touch `EntriesRepository` in any way — purely the recognition
35	  half, by design (this is exactly what used to be fused with entry creation in RF01's `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`
36	  and is now split apart).
37	- **Who calls it**: `InsertionModalBloc`, on `PhotoSourceSelected` (first attempt) and `RetryRequested` (every
38	  subsequent attempt against the same held path) — contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md.
39	
40	## `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` (NEW, replaces `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` + `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`)
41	
42	```dart
43	class ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase {
44	  const ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase({
45	    required CreateEntryUseCase createEntryUseCase,
46	    required ConnectivityChecker connectivityChecker,
47	  });
48	
49	  Future<Either<ConfirmEntrySaveFailure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source);
50	}
51	
52	sealed class ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
53	class ConfirmEntrySaveOffline extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {}
54	class ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed extends ConfirmEntrySaveFailure {
55	  const ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(this.failure);
56	  final Failure failure;
57	}
58	```
59	
60	- **Preconditions**: `content` is expected non-empty/non-whitespace — enforced by the bloc before calling this
61	  (the "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" trigger is itself gated on that, FR-009), not re-validated here (this
62	  usecase trusts its caller, the same contract `CreateEntryUseCase` itself already has).
63	- **Behavior**: checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first; `false` short-circuits to
64	  `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` without calling `CreateEntryUseCase` (FR-010/the Edge Cases' "both still
65	  require connectivity" wording). Otherwise delegates to `CreateEntryUseCase(content, source)` and wraps its
66	  result.
67	- **Who calls it**: `InsertionModalBloc`, on `AudioSaveConfirmed`, `PhotoSaveConfirmed`, and
68	  `PhotoSaveWithoutTextRequested` — the one shared seam for every entry this unit creates, parameterized only
69	  by `content` and `source` (research.md R7's consolidation rationale).
70	- **Deleted**: `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/save_audio_entry_usecase.dart` and
71	  `save_photo_entry_usecase.dart` (and their `SaveAudioFailure`/`SavePhotoFailure` sealed types), along with
72	  their test files — fully superseded, no remaining caller.
73	
74	## `AudioTranscriptionRepository` / `PhotoRecognitionRepository` (unchanged interfaces, new call sites)
75	
76	Both interfaces (`specs/003-multimodal-capture/contracts/*.md`) keep their exact signatures —
77	`transcribe(String) -> Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` and
78	`recognize(String) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>`. This unit changes only *who* calls them and *when*:
79	`AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` is now called directly by `InsertionModalBloc` (no usecase — R1
80	removes the one orchestration step, the connectivity check, that used to justify a wrapper);
81	`PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` is now called only from inside `RecognizePhotoUseCase`, never
82	directly by the bloc.
83	
84	## RNF07 coverage this unit's tests must provide
85	
86	| Unit | Scenarios |
87	|---|---|
88	| `RecognizePhotoUseCase` | offline short-circuit (no repository call); repository `Right`; repository `Left(OcrNoTextFailure)`; repository `Left(<other Failure>)` — against a mock `PhotoRecognitionRepository` + fake `ConnectivityChecker`. |
89	| `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` | offline short-circuit (no `CreateEntryUseCase` call); `CreateEntryUseCase` `Right`; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Left` — against a mock `CreateEntryUseCase` + fake `ConnectivityChecker`. |
90	| `InsertionModalBloc` (bloc_test) | Áudio: stop → Processing → Transcribed (success) / Failure (empty/error); edited text carried into the create-entry call; Salvar double-tap ignored while Saving; stale-result guard (switch tabs mid-Processing, confirm the late result is dropped); retry re-uses the same path. Foto: the same shape, plus the offline-before-OCR path and "Salvar só a foto" creating an entry with the fixed placeholder and *no* further `recognize()` call. |
91

267	- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in

275

278	Task: "Create Entry entity + enums in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
279	Task: "Create ConnectivityChecker in lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart"

299	2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
300	3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
301	4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
302	   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.
303	
304	### Incremental Delivery
305	
306	1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
307	2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
308	3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
309	   criterion, SC-001).
310	4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
311	   structurally identical.
312	5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.

320	  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
321	  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
322	  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/

# Tasks: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. The constitution's RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) and RNF09
(15/15 write-endpoint failure scenarios via `mocktail`) gates apply to this unit, and
quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section explicitly names the domain/data tests this unit's
coverage depends on — so test tasks are generated alongside implementation, matching
F000/RF03's existing `bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US4, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all four stories share one page/bloc
(`InsertionModalPage`/`InsertionModalBloc`) by deliberate design (research.md R6) — "independent"
here means each story's acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own
once Foundational is done, not that each story gets its own screen or bloc. `entries/` (research.md
R8) is built once in Foundational because all three capture modalities (US1–US3) depend on
`CreateEntryUseCase` to persist their result.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (text entry), US2 (audio entry), US3 (photo entry), US4 (abandoning a capture
  leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (F000/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. All
new files live under `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/features/capture/`, `test/features/entries/`,
`test/features/capture/`, and one new `lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`; one existing
F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`) and the shared `service_locator.dart`/`pubspec.yaml`/iOS
project files are touched at documented extension points.

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Dependencies and native-project changes every later task needs.

- [X] T001 Add `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, `connectivity_plus`, and `path_provider` to `pubspec.yaml` dependencies (research.md R1–R5), then run `fvm flutter pub get`
- [X] T002 [P] Add `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`, and `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (three one-line usage strings) to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` — required before any mic/camera/gallery access is even attempted on-device or in the Simulator (research.md R1/R3)
- [X] T003 Raise `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` from `15.0` to `15.6` across all three build configurations (Debug/Release/Profile) in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` — `whisper_ggml`'s documented minimum (research.md R2)
- [X] T004 [P] Bundle the `ggml-tiny` (quantized `q5_1` variant preferred for size) Whisper model asset under `assets/models/` and declare it under `flutter.assets` in `pubspec.yaml` — delivered as a bundled asset, never downloaded over the network, so on-device transcription stays network-independent from first launch (research.md R2)

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The shared `entries` feature (the one sanctioned seam every capture modality creates
an entry through), the cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker`, and the Insertion Modal's
page/bloc/tab-bar shell every user story extends. No story's acceptance scenario can be exercised,
manually or in a test, until this phase is done.

- [X] T067 [US4] Confirm `InsertionModalPage`'s `showModalBottomSheet` call (wired in T027) constructs a brand-new `BlocProvider<InsertionModalBloc>` on every open, so no tab selection, draft text, or sub-state survives a close-then-reopen cycle ("MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened" — FR-002) — depends on T027, T065

**Checkpoint**: All four user stories are independently functional.

---

## Phase 7: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns

**Purpose**: The constitution/quickstart gates that span every story above.

- [X] T068 [P] Run `fvm flutter analyze` and resolve any `always_use_package_imports`/lint findings under `lib/features/entries/` and `lib/features/capture/`
- [X] T069 [P] Run `test/architecture/domain_purity_test.dart` and confirm it still reports 0 violations with `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/` included — no `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, or `whisper_ggml` type may appear in either `domain/` (RNF06)
- [X] T070 Run `fvm flutter test --coverage`, extract `lib/**/domain/**` via `lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info`, and confirm ≥80% coverage with `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/` included (RNF07)

## Phase 8: Convergence

- [X] T072 Replace the three hardcoded pixel literals in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/audio_waveform.dart` (`EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2)`, `width: 4`, `height: 8 + normalized * 32`) with the existing `DesignTokens.spacingXs`/`spacingSm`/`spacingXl` constants (values 4/8/32 already defined in `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`) per Constitution Principle IV (contradicts)

---

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup (T004's bundled model asset is read by US2's T034) — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) should be done first — it is the only story with no recognition dependency, and it is
    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/
    `insertion_modal_state.dart`/`insertion_modal_page.dart` files US1 touches (T041/T059 both
    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently
    testable once done, per spec.md's own priority ordering (P1 before P2).
  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).
- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T002, T004 (Setup) in parallel with T001/T003 once each is independently actionable.
- T005, T013 (entities/connectivity) in parallel within Foundational; T015/T016/T018 (event/state/
  tab-bar skeletons) in parallel with each other and with the `entries` feature tasks.
- T008, T010, T012 (test files) can be written in parallel with each other once their respective
  implementation task lands.
- T020/T021 (US1 bloc event/state additions) in parallel with T022/T023 (US1 usecase + its test) —
  different files, both depend only on Foundational.
- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in
  parallel with each other.
- T036/T038 and T054/T056 (test files) in parallel with their respective sibling implementation
  task's dependents once that task lands.

---

## Parallel Example: Foundational Phase

```bash
# Launch independent entity/interface files together:
Task: "Create Entry entity + enums in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
Task: "Create ConnectivityChecker in lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart"
Task: "Create CaptureTab enum + InsertionModalEvent base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart"
Task: "Create InsertionModalState base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart"
```

## Parallel Example: User Story 2 domain layer

```bash
Task: "Create RecognitionFailure sealed type in lib/features/capture/domain/entities/recognition_failure.dart"
Task: "Create AudioCaptureRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart"
Task: "Create AudioTranscriptionRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart"
```

---

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
   criterion, SC-001).
4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
   structurally identical.
5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/
  insertion-modal-bloc.md chose (mirroring RF03's `VaultBloc`), not a same-file conflict to avoid.
- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code
  (research.md R7). `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()`, by contrast, is a real network call
  and reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, RF02's
  (not-yet-built) dedicated recognition-state screens, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all
  explicitly out of scope (FR-012, FR-013).
- `OcrResult.confidence` is carried through the full pipeline (T049, T055) but never branched on
  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's
  concern (Clarification 3).

# Tasks: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/004-stt-ocr-processing/`

Check as "PASS (gate carried into tasks)", and quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section names the

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US5, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all five stories edit the one existing `InsertionModalBloc`/

acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own once Foundational is done,
not that each story gets its own screen or bloc — same convention RF01's own tasks.md used). Unlike
RF01 (building fresh), this unit edits a working app: the Áudio (US1/US2) and Foto (US3/US4) handler
rewrites are sequenced so the app keeps compiling and the *other* modality keeps its RF01 behavior
until its own story phase lands — `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` and
`CaptureFailureBand` are deleted only once nothing references them any more (end of US3/US4), not
up front.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (audio review/save), US2 (audio recognition failure/retry), US3 (photo
  review/save), US4 (photo recognition failure/retry), US5 (abandoning mid-recognition or
  mid-review leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (RF01/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. Every
file this unit touches already exists inside `lib/features/capture/` or `lib/core/`; no new feature
folder, no new top-level directory (plan.md Scale/Scope).

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Project initialization — N/A for this unit.

No setup tasks apply. This unit adds no new package, no native-project change, and no new `.env`
variable — it reuses RF01's full stack as-is (plan.md Technical Context, Primary Dependencies: "No
additions"). Proceed directly to Foundational.

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The one new shared usecase every "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" trigger across both
modalities funnels through (`ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`), the two new design tokens the prototype's
"Erro" states and photo thumbnail need, and the new `RecognitionErrorView` widget both modalities'
Erro states will render through. `RecognizePhotoUseCase` is **not** here — it is built in US3,
since only the Foto pipeline needs it (see US3's rationale).

**⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story work can begin until this phase is complete.

- [ ] T001 [P] Add `sizePhotoThumbnail = 64` and `sizeStatusIcon = 32` to the Sizes section of `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (research.md R2 — the "small thumbnail" and the recurring red warning icon prototype-extract.md §2.3 names for the Áudio/Foto "Erro" states and Foto's "Reconhecido"/"Erro" thumbnail; `colorError`, already present, is reused unchanged for the icon/copy color)
- [ ] T002 [P] Create `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` and sealed `ConfirmEntrySaveFailure`/`ConfirmEntrySaveOffline`/`ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed` in `lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart` (data-model.md, contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md): `call(String content, EntrySource source)` checks `ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection()` first — `false` short-circuits to `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` without calling `CreateEntryUseCase` at all (FR-010 / Edge Cases' "both still require connectivity"); otherwise delegates to `CreateEntryUseCase(content, source)` and wraps its `Left`/`Right`. Does not re-validate `content` non-emptiness — that is the bloc's job before calling this (FR-009), the same contract `CreateEntryUseCase` itself already has
- [ ] T003 [P] Write `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` tests in `test/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase_test.dart` against a fake `CreateEntryUseCase` + fake `ConnectivityChecker` (contracts/recognition-and-save-usecases.md's RNF07 table): offline → `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())` with `CreateEntryUseCase` never invoked; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Right(entry)` passes through unchanged; `CreateEntryUseCase` `Left(failure)` maps to `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(failure))` — depends on T002

Add it **alongside** the existing `CaptureFailureBand` — do not remove `CaptureFailureBand` yet, since `AudioTabView`/`FotoTabView` still reference it until US2/US4 migrate their own "Erro" sub-views (research.md R4) — depends on T001

**Checkpoint**: `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`, the two new design tokens, and `RecognitionErrorView` all
exist and are wired through DI/available to import. The Áudio and Foto tabs still behave exactly as
RF01 built them (single generic "Saving" spinner, plain `CaptureFailureBand` on failure) until their
own story phases rewrite the handlers below.

---

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Reviewing and saving a transcribed audio entry (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Stopping a recording no longer saves itself — it shows "Áudio — Processando", then lands
on an editable "Áudio — Transcrito" review with its own explicit "Salvar"; the entry created on
"Salvar" carries exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text.

**Independent Test**: Record a short note, stop, observe "Áudio — Processando", confirm "Áudio —
Transcrito" shows the transcribed text editable with "Salvar" enabled, optionally edit it, tap
"Salvar", and confirm one new entry exists with origin "audio" and exactly the (possibly edited)
reviewed text as content.

### Implementation for User Story 1

- [ ] T007 [P] [US1] Add `AudioReviewTextChanged(text)` and `AudioSaveConfirmed` events to `lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart` (data-model.md) — depends on Foundational

- [ ] T009 [US1] Add an `_onAudioReviewTextChanged` handler to `InsertionModalBloc`: from `InsertionModalAudioTranscribed` or `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure` only, sets `_audioReviewText = event.text` and re-emits the same state subtype with the updated text, holding `duration`/other fields unchanged — depends on T006, T007
- [ ] T010 [US1] Add an `_onAudioSaveConfirmed` handler to `InsertionModalBloc`: ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioTranscribed || state is InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure`, `_audioReviewText` is non-empty/non-whitespace after `.trim()` (FR-009 — the "Salvar MUST be unavailable whenever the editable text field is empty or whitespace-only" guard), and no save is already in flight for this capture (FR-010 double-tap guard); emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving(_audioReviewText, duration)`, awaits `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase(_audioReviewText, EntrySource.audio)`; `Right(entry)` clears `_pendingAudioPath` and triggers the existing one-shot `closeRequests` side effect; `Left(ConfirmEntrySaveOffline())`/`Left(ConfirmEntrySaveCreationFailed(f))` map to `InsertionModalAudioSaveFailure(_audioReviewText, duration, message)`, keeping the audio file and reviewed text both held so a repeat `AudioSaveConfirmed` is the retry (research.md R5) — depends on T006, T007, T002
- [ ] T011 [US1] Update `InsertionModalBloc`'s constructor: remove the `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` dependency, add `AudioTranscriptionRepository` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`; register the `AudioReviewTextChanged`/`AudioSaveConfirmed` handlers via `on<...>()` — leave `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` untouched (Foto is migrated in US3) — depends on T008, T009, T010

- [ ] T013 [US1] Extend `AudioTabView` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/audio_tab_view.dart` with three new sub-views: "Áudio — Processando" (a spinner — `CaptureLoadingIndicator` or equivalent — in place of the stop control, `Opacity(0.35)` around the existing `AudioWaveform`, the caption "Transcrevendo...", and the recorded `duration` in `DesignTokens.textMonoCaption` — FR-001); "Áudio — Transcrito" (an editable `TextFormField` seeded from `text`, dispatching `AudioReviewTextChanged` on change, the same `duration` caption, and a "Salvar" `ElevatedButton` enabled iff `text.trim().isNotEmpty`, dispatching `AudioSaveConfirmed` — FR-002/FR-009); "Áudio — SaveFailure" (the same editable field plus an inline message in `DesignTokens.colorError`, "Salvar" still enabled for the retry — research.md R5) — depends on T006, T007, T010
- [ ] T014 [US1] Update `lib/core/di/service_locator.dart`'s `InsertionModalBloc` factory registration to inject `AudioTranscriptionRepository` and `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase` in place of `SaveAudioEntryUseCase` (keep `SavePhotoEntryUseCase` injected for now) — depends on T011, T004

it.

**Goal**: A transcription failure shows "Áudio — Erro" with "Tentar novamente", re-attempting

discards the audio and creates no entry.

and confirm the same held audio is retried.

save, failure, retry, abandon) now matches the prototype end to end.

---

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - Reviewing and saving a recognized photo entry (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Supplying an image no longer saves itself — it shows "Foto — Processando OCR", then lands
on an editable "Foto — Reconhecido" review (thumbnail + text) with its own explicit "Salvar"; the
entry created on "Salvar" carries exactly the (possibly edited) reviewed text.

**Independent Test**: Supply the legible-text fixture, observe "Foto — Processando OCR", confirm
"Foto — Reconhecido" shows the extracted text editable next to a thumbnail with "Salvar" enabled,
optionally edit it, tap "Salvar", and confirm one new entry exists with origin "photo" and exactly
the (possibly edited) reviewed text as content.

### Implementation for User Story 3

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No tasks — proceed directly to Foundational.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: No dependencies — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–7)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) and US2 (P1) together build the complete Áudio pipeline; US2 depends on US1's
    `AudioStopRequested` rewrite (T008) already existing to retry against.
  - US3 (P2) and US4 (P2) together build the complete Foto pipeline the same way; US4 depends on
    US3's `PhotoSourceSelected` rewrite (T024). US3 additionally depends on US1's `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`
    wiring (T011) and `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`-removal readiness (T014) before it can delete both old
    usecases in T030 — do US1/US2 before US3/US4, per spec.md's own priority ordering.
  - US5 (P3) depends on US2's and US4's narrower abandonment guards (T017, T038) already existing
    to consolidate into the full guard (T040/T041), and on US1's/US3's stale-result guards (T008,
    T024) to build its tests against.
- **Polish (Phase 8)**: Depends on all five stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- State/event additions before the bloc handler rewrite that needs them; the bloc handler rewrite
  before the DI update that injects its new dependencies; DI update before the widget sub-views that
  read the new states through `context.read<InsertionModalBloc>()`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can run immediately after) each handler task, per this project's
  existing convention of extending one shared `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` across a story's tasks
  rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (states + events + bloc handlers + DI + widget + tests) before moving to the next
  priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T001, T002/T003, T005 (Foundational) in parallel with each other — different files.
- T006/T007 (US1 state/event additions) in parallel with each other; same for T022/T023 (US3).
- T020/T021 (US3's `RecognizePhotoUseCase` + its test) in parallel with T022/T023 once Foundational
  lands.
- T015, T019, T031, T039, T042 (bloc test extensions) in parallel with each other once their
  respective sibling implementation tasks land, since they all extend the same file sequentially in
  practice but have no cross-task code dependency beyond that file existing.

**Goal**: A safety property spanning both modalities — closing the modal, navigating away, or

still running, succeeded and sitting in review, or failed) never leaves a persisted entry behind.

confirm no entry was created in any case.

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No tasks — proceed directly to Foundational.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: No dependencies — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–7)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) and US2 (P1) together build the complete Áudio pipeline; US2 depends on US1's
    `AudioStopRequested` rewrite (T008) already existing to retry against.
  - US3 (P2) and US4 (P2) together build the complete Foto pipeline the same way; US4 depends on
    US3's `PhotoSourceSelected` rewrite (T024). US3 additionally depends on US1's `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`
    wiring (T011) and `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`-removal readiness (T014) before it can delete both old
    usecases in T030 — do US1/US2 before US3/US4, per spec.md's own priority ordering.
  - US5 (P3) depends on US2's and US4's narrower abandonment guards (T017, T038) already existing
    to consolidate into the full guard (T040/T041), and on US1's/US3's stale-result guards (T008,
    T024) to build its tests against.
- **Polish (Phase 8)**: Depends on all five stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- State/event additions before the bloc handler rewrite that needs them; the bloc handler rewrite
  before the DI update that injects its new dependencies; DI update before the widget sub-views that
  read the new states through `context.read<InsertionModalBloc>()`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can run immediately after) each handler task, per this project's
  existing convention of extending one shared `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` across a story's tasks
  rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (states + events + bloc handlers + DI + widget + tests) before moving to the next
  priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T001, T002/T003, T005 (Foundational) in parallel with each other — different files.
- T006/T007 (US1 state/event additions) in parallel with each other; same for T022/T023 (US3).
- T020/T021 (US3's `RecognizePhotoUseCase` + its test) in parallel with T022/T023 once Foundational
  lands.
- T015, T019, T031, T039, T042 (bloc test extensions) in parallel with each other once their
  respective sibling implementation tasks land, since they all extend the same file sequentially in
  practice but have no cross-task code dependency beyond that file existing.

---

## Parallel Example: Foundational Phase

```bash
Task: "Add sizePhotoThumbnail/sizeStatusIcon to lib/core/design_tokens.dart"
Task: "Create ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase in lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/confirm_entry_save_usecase.dart"
Task: "Create RecognitionErrorView in lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/capture_status_views.dart"
```

## Parallel Example: User Story 3 domain layer

```bash
Task: "Create RecognizePhotoUseCase in lib/features/capture/domain/usecases/recognize_photo_usecase.dart"
Task: "Add InsertionModalFotoProcessing/Reconhecido states to insertion_modal_state.dart"
Task: "Add PhotoReviewTextChanged/PhotoSaveConfirmed events to insertion_modal_event.dart"
```

---

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
2. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
3. **STOP and VALIDATE**: record a note, stop, watch "Processando" → "Transcrito", edit the text,
   tap "Salvar" — a new "audio" entry exists with the edited text, and the modal closes. Foto still
   behaves exactly as RF01 built it.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Foundational → `ConfirmEntrySaveUseCase`/tokens/`RecognitionErrorView` exist, nothing visible
   changes yet.
2. Add US1 → Audio's happy-path review flow works end to end (SC-001).
3. Add US2 → Audio's failure/retry/abandon path completes the modality (SC-003, SC-006).
4. Add US3 → Foto's happy-path review flow works end to end (SC-002); both RF01-era save usecases
   are deleted.
5. Add US4 → Foto's failure/retry/"Salvar só a foto"/abandon path completes the modality (SC-003,
   SC-004, SC-006).
6. Add US5 → the cross-modality abandonment safety property is fully consolidated and tested.
7. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T008/T016/T033/T040/T041 for
  the bloc; T007/T023/T032 for events; T006/T022 for states; T012/T028 for the page) — this mirrors
  RF01's own tasks.md precedent: a deliberate consequence of one shared bloc/page serving all tabs,
  not a same-file conflict to avoid.
- `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` and `CaptureFailureBand` are left alive and in use
  until the task that deletes them (T030, T037) — deleting them earlier would break whichever
  modality hadn't been migrated yet, since the app must keep compiling and the non-migrated tab must
  keep working at every checkpoint.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, any
  native iOS project file, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all explicitly out of scope (FR-012,
  FR-013).
- `OcrResult.confidence` is read in T024 but never branched on anywhere, including in the UI (T029),
  per spec.md's resolved Clarification 3 — identical treatment to RF01's own precedent for the same
  field.
